# Terrace Sun

> Terrace Sun calculates hours of direct sunlight for any address from OpenStreetMap building footprints and heights: per street-facing wall, per floor, per season. It publishes a 0-100 Sun Score (grades A to E) for property listings, a branded sun-exposure report, a one-line listing badge and a JSON API. It also checks sun on café terraces, roofs and event spots.

Figures are direct-beam sun on a clear day over flat ground, sampled every 10 minutes (5 in the interactive tool); trees, awnings and terrain are not modelled. Sun Score = share of daylight hours with direct sun on the sunniest street-facing wall at the given floor, averaged over 20 March, 21 June, 22 September and 21 December; A >= 70, B >= 55, C >= 40, D >= 25, E < 25.

## Docs
- [Sun exposure in property listings: how to measure it, show it and sell it](https://terrace-sun.netlify.app/blog/sun-exposure-property-listings/index.md): method, Sun Score definition, worked example in Rome, listing copy, API fields, tool definition for AI assistants, limits, sources
- [OpenAPI specification](https://terrace-sun.netlify.app/openapi.json): GET /api/v1/sun?lat&lon&floor&floors&height&name&year&key
- [Product, pricing and API reference](https://terrace-sun.netlify.app/listings/): Free (5 reports a month), Agent EUR 19/month, Agency EUR 79/month, Portal API EUR 390/month, single report EUR 9

## Tools
- [Sun exposure API](https://terrace-sun.netlify.app/api/v1/sun?lat=41.8799368&lon=12.4768852&floor=5&floors=6&key=demo): JSON; key "demo" works for testing
- [Report page](https://terrace-sun.netlify.app/report/?lat=41.8799368&lon=12.4768852&floor=5&floors=6&name=Example): /report/?lat&lon&floor&floors&name&agency&logo&agent
- [Interactive tool](https://terrace-sun.netlify.app/): café terraces, hotel rooms, holiday rentals, roofs for solar, wedding spots, public spaces (?mode=cafe|hotel|host|solar|wedding|city&lat&lon&date)
- [Listing badge](https://terrace-sun.netlify.app/embed.js): <script async src="https://terrace-sun.netlify.app/embed.js" data-lat data-lon data-floor data-floors data-name data-agency></script>

## Optional
- [Sunniest cafés in Testaccio, San Saba and Garbatella, Rome](https://terrace-sun.netlify.app/rome-sunny-cafes/): ranked by morning, midday and afternoon sun
